title: 第7596章 第三轮第7595章 开始武仙组考核
slug: 万古第一神第7596章第三轮
content_zh:
总分综合了个人和团队的分数，它不仅代表个人能力，还与队友的存活率息息相关。
毕竟每淘汰一个队友，总分就会减少五分之一，存活率因此显得无比重要。
李天命若有所思道，“万宗帝战当中，危机无数，有对手，也有各种寻宝路上的危险，哪怕队友本就不弱，也需要一个强大的团队大脑来指挥，所以能保存队伍人数，并且寻得大量宝物的，绝非等闲之辈，不仅是战力这么简单。”
“你说对了，正是这样有勇有谋的人，才能算真正的人才，能打当然也重要，但不是唯一参考指标，这一点不论是内疆加盟国选人，还是‘他们’选人，其实都是一样的。”姬玄鉴稍微避着万曜等人，在李天命耳边说道。
“明白了。”李天命笑着点点头，又道，“不过即使他们强大，我亦无惧。”
“你也真的别太掉以轻心了，小心阴沟里翻船。”姬玄鉴有些没好气道，“你要知道，就算算上我，咱们也不过是两个稍微能打一些的，别人可是整支队伍都不弱。”
“来试试就知道了。”李天命微微一笑。
“算了，我不管你了，爱咋咋。”姬玄鉴微微叹气。
毕竟除了共和神天之外，万宗帝战很多人的目标也就是被内疆加盟国选中。
问题是她本来就是加盟国的公主，哪里还用得着这种机缘，所以她其实真不太在意万宗帝战的成绩。
虽然口中说不管，但姬玄鉴既然已经开口提起第三轮，便还是决定要给李天命解释到底。
她接着耐心介绍道，“其实，能参加第三轮万宗帝战的人，已经算是外疆最强的一批天才了，这一百二十八个成功晋级的人里面，应该都没有纯粹外疆的，几乎都是内疆人，像你这样的，真是一个异类！”
“奇迹不就是可能性小到极致的必然吗？外疆宗门这么多天才弟子，这么多岁月的变迁里，也该有奇迹发生了吧？”李天命微微一笑道。
“那我从那样的茫茫人海里找到你，是不是也算一种奇迹？”姬玄鉴眼睛一亮道。
“算个屁！明明是我队伍缺人，只是刚好遇见你。”李天命笑道。
姬玄鉴一时语塞，想要动手，又不一定能打过李天命，于是只能抱着双臂生闷气。
李天命则继续带着九人的队伍前进。
其实如今他的帝分已经完全足够从这一轮当中晋级，继续寻找对手也只不过是为了拿万宗帝战的第一的名次而已。
在彻底展现出了实力后，李天命再打赢其他队伍，对外界众人而言也已经是习以为常。
毕竟，他连四阶进化境的银妍郡主都能碾压，已经足够证明了自己的实力！

而在自身帝分已经足够之后，李天命也不再依赖银尘的消息，彻底随心所欲，在倒悬塔上层的各个废墟、各个角落当中纵横。
但凡碰见活人，不管强队弱队，一律抢走宝物！
这个过程虽然比银尘指引稍微要慢一些，但对李天命的目标而言，也已经足够了。
最重要的是，银尘因此没有了暴露的风险。
渐渐地，李天命自己手中的宝物也越积累越多，当然，他也基本都会分一部分给姬玄鉴。
反正李天命能满足自己的需要，这多的宝物作为人情，给乾烽天帝看到自己的态度，这笔买卖很值！
“小李子自己的实力，估计都快要称霸整个星组了，现在加上棂儿的力量，更是几乎横扫，谁能拦我们？”
在李天命刚灭了一队之后，燧神曜有些振奋地说道。
“我们的目标早就不止是拿成绩拿排名了，更是要让这武仙组的人对我们的表现感到惊艳。”极光温柔笑道。
也正因如此，李天命对待碰见的对手之时，出手即是碾压！
content_en:
The total score combines individual and team scores. It not only represents individual ability, but is also closely related to the survival rate of teammates.
After all, every time a teammate is eliminated, the total score will be reduced by one-fifth, so the survival rate is extremely important.
Li Tianming said thoughtfully, "In the Wan Zong Emperor War, there are countless crises, there are opponents, and there are also various dangers on the treasure hunt. Even if the teammates are not weak, they still need a strong team brain to command, so those who can save the number of team members and find a large number of treasures are by no means just ordinary people. It is not just as simple as combat power."
"You are right, it is such brave and resourceful people who can be considered real talents. Being able to fight is of course important, but it is not the only reference indicator. This point is actually the same whether it is the selection of people from the Inner Xinjiang franchise countries or the selection of 'them'." Ji Xuanjian avoided Wan Yao and others and said in Li Tianming's ear.
"I understand." Li Tianming nodded with a smile and said, "But even if they are strong, I am not afraid."
"You really shouldn't take it too lightly, be careful of capsizing in the gutter." Ji Xuanjian said angrily, "You have to know, even if you include me, we are just two people who are slightly better at fighting. Others are not weak as a whole team."
"You'll know after you try it." Li Tianming smiled slightly.
"Forget it, I don't care about you anymore, do whatever you want." Ji Xuanjian sighed slightly.
After all, in addition to the Republic of God, the goal of many people in the Wan Zong Emperor War is to be selected by the Inner Territory Alliance.
The problem is that she is a princess from a participating country, so there is no need for such an opportunity, so she really doesn't care much about the results of the Wan Zong Emperor War.
Although he said he didn't care, since Ji Xuanjian had already mentioned the third round, he decided to explain it to Li Tianming.
She then introduced patiently, "Actually, those who can participate in the third round of the Ten Thousand Sects Emperor War are already considered the strongest geniuses in Outer Borders. Among the 128 people who have successfully advanced, there should be none who are purely from Outer Borders. Almost all of them are from Inner Borders. People like you are really an anomaly!"
"Isn't a miracle inevitable when the possibility is extremely small? There are so many talented disciples in the Outer Border Sect. After so many years of changes, a miracle should have happened, right?" Li Tianming said with a slight smile.
"Then it's a miracle that I found you in such a vast sea of ​​people?" Ji Xuanjian's eyes lit up.
"Forget it! My team is obviously short of people, but I just happened to meet you." Li Tianming said with a smile.
Ji Xuanjian was at a loss for words. He wanted to take action, but he might not be able to beat Li Tianming, so he could only fold his arms and sulk.
Li Tianming continued to lead the team of nine people forward.
In fact, his imperial points are now enough to advance from this round, and continuing to look for opponents is just to get the first place in the Ten Thousand Sects Imperial Battle.
After thoroughly demonstrating his strength, Li Tianming has become accustomed to winning against other teams.
After all, he can even crush Princess Yinyan at the fourth level of evolution, which is enough to prove his strength!
And after his own emperor points were enough, Li Tianming no longer relied on Yin Chen's news, and he completely followed his own desires, roaming around in the ruins and corners of the upper level of the upside-down tower.
Whenever you encounter a living person, regardless of the strong or weak team, you will steal the treasure!
Although this process is slightly slower than Yin Chen's guidance, it is enough for Li Tianming's goal.
Most importantly, there is no risk of exposure to silver dust.
Gradually, Li Tianming accumulated more and more treasures in his hands. Of course, he would basically give some of them to Ji Xuanjian.
Anyway, Li Tianming can meet his needs. These many treasures are a favor and show Emperor Qianfeng Tianming his attitude. This transaction is worth it!
"Xiao Lizi's own strength is probably close to dominating the entire star group. Now coupled with Ling'er's strength, he is almost sweeping.Who can stop us? "
After Li Tianming had just wiped out a team, Sui Shen Yao said excitedly.
"Our goal has long been not only to get results and rankings, but also to make the people in this Wuxian group amazed by our performance. "Jiu Guang smiled softly.
Because of this, when Li Tianming dealt with the opponents he met, he would crush them with every strike!
